section.hud-title.title: Title Screen
title-screen.label: Title Screen
title-screen.description: Original keeps the game's title. Reimagined draws a wider scene over the same sequence.
title-motion.label: Motion
title-motion.description: Drifting moves the scene and the clouds slowly while the title waits.
title-sword.label: Sword
title-sword.description: The sword planted in the title. Progress picks it from the most advanced save.
title-sword.hint: Press to step to the next sword shown in the title.
title-follows-progress.label: Follows Progress
title-follows-progress.description: The world, and the sword set to Progress, come from the most advanced save.
section.hud-display.title: Display
hud-mode.label: HUD Mode
hud-mode.description: Original renders the HUD on the game canvas. Enhanced replaces selected parts with a high-quality overlay that supports widescreen and smooth animations.
hud-enhanced-parts.label: Enhanced Parts
hud-enhanced-parts.description: Choose which HUD components are replaced by the enhanced overlay. Parts not selected will continue using the original game rendering.
hud-style.label: Style
hud-style.description: Original is the game's own HUD. Modern hands the HUD and the pause menu to the app and adds the modern control scheme. It needs a 16:9 or wider display.
hud-ratio.label: Aspect Ratio
hud-ratio.description: Aspect ratio for the enhanced overlay. Match keeps it in sync with the game viewport.
section.hud-main.title: Main HUD
hud-heart-mode.label: Heart Style
hud-heart-mode.description: How life hearts are drawn. Smooth fills fractional hearts gradually instead of in 4 steps.
hud-magic-mode.label: Magic Meter
hud-magic-mode.description: How the magic power bar is rendered. Accurate shows the true value instead of rounding to 1/8ths.
hud-count-layout.label: Counter Layout
hud-count-layout.description: Position of the rupee, bomb, arrow, and key counters relative to the screen.
hud-countdown-style.label: Countdown Timer
hud-countdown-style.description: How the countdown for timed events, such as the digging game or the super bomb, is drawn.
section.hud-dialog.title: Dialog Box
section.hud-dialog-box.title: Box
dialog-box.label: Box
dialog-box.description: Original keeps the game's box. Enhanced draws it as an overlay you can style.
dialog-box-fit.label: Size
dialog-box-fit.description: Full keeps the original size. Message sizes the box once to the whole message. Fit follows the text as it types.
dialog-button-prompts.label: Button Prompts
dialog-button-prompts.description: Shows the buttons that act on a message under its box: choose, confirm, next, complete and faster.
section.hud-dialog-text.title: Text
dialog-font.label: Font
dialog-font.description: Original uses the game's glyphs. Modern uses the app's dialogue font.
dialog-font-scale.label: Font Size
dialog-font-scale.description: How large the text draws. Smaller fits more in the box.
dialog-ink-color.label: Ink Color
dialog-ink-color.description: The color the modern font is written in.
dialog-stroke-color.label: Stroke Color
dialog-stroke-color.description: The outline color around each modern glyph.
dialog-stroke-width.label: Stroke Width
dialog-stroke-width.description: How thick the outline is, in game pixels.
section.hud-dialog-highlight.title: Highlights
hud-highlight-primary.label: Highlight Primary
hud-highlight-secondary.label: Highlight Secondary
section.hud-dialog-border.title: Border
dialog-border.label: Border
dialog-border.description: The game's tiles, no border, one line, or a thin line inside a thicker one.
dialog-border.hint: Single and Double unlock the line options.
dialog-border-thickness.label: Thickness
dialog-border-thickness.description: How heavy the drawn line is.
dialog-border-color.label: Border Color
dialog-border-color.description: The color of the drawn line and the corner marks.
dialog-corner.label: Corners
dialog-corner.description: Square, rounded, or cut at a diagonal.
dialog-corner-mark.label: Corner Marks
dialog-corner-mark.description: A small mark inside each corner.
dialog-corner-mark-angle.label: Mark Angle
dialog-corner-mark-angle.description: Turns the marks; each corner mirrors the top-left one.
section.hud-dialog-background.title: Background
dialog-ground-color.label: Background Color
dialog-box-opacity.label: Background Opacity
dialog-box-opacity.description: How solid the ground is, from clear to solid.
dialog-ground-fade.label: Fade Edges
dialog-ground-fade.description: Fades the background out toward its edges. Only without a border.
dialog-floating-ground.label: Behind Telepathy
dialog-floating-ground.description: Also draws the background behind borderless messages, such as telepathy.
dialog-intro-telepathy-ground.label: Behind Intro Telepathy
dialog-intro-telepathy-ground.descriptio: Draws it behind the first telepathic call of the intro, while the hero is still in bed.
section.hud-dialog-texture.title: Texture
dialog-texture.label: Pattern
dialog-texture.description: A repeating pattern on the ground behind the text.
dialog-texture.hint: None turns the pattern options off.
dialog-texture-color.label: Pattern Color
dialog-texture-color.description: The color the pattern is drawn in.
dialog-texture-opacity.label: Pattern Opacity
dialog-texture-animation.label: Animation
dialog-texture-animation.description: Still, sliding, drifting, appearing at random, or breathing.
dialog-texture-speed.label: Animation Speed
section.hud-dialog-pattern.title: Pattern Layout
dialog-texture-scale.label: Size
dialog-texture-scale.description: How large each cell of the pattern draws.
dialog-texture-density.label: Density
dialog-texture-scatter.label: Scatter
dialog-texture-scatter.description: How far cells stray from the grid; at zero they line up.
